fixed_text.certification: This is to certify that {name} with Matriculation Number {matric} of the Department of {department} has successfully completed the Students' Industrial Work Experience Scheme (SIWES) at {organisation} for a period of {duration}.
fixed_text.siwes_background: The Students' Industrial Work Experience Scheme (SIWES) was established by the Industrial Training Fund (ITF) in 1973 to provide students with practical industrial experience related to their courses of study. The scheme operates through a tripartite arrangement involving the student, the institution and the host organisation, with the ITF providing the scheme framework.
siwes_objectives: Provide an avenue for students in institutions of higher learning to acquire industrial skills and experience in their course of study.
Prepare students for the industrial work situation they are likely to meet after graduation.
Expose students to work methods and techniques in handling equipment and machinery that may not be available in their institutions.
Make the transition from school to the world of work easier and enhance students' contacts for later job placement.
Provide students with an opportunity to apply their knowledge in real work situations, thereby bridging the gap between theory and practice.
Enlist and strengthen employers' involvement in the entire educational process.
fixed_text.siwes_importance: SIWES gives students an opportunity to apply classroom learning in a practical work environment and to become familiar with workplace methods and equipment relevant to their studies.
fixed_text.itf_reference: Industrial Training Fund (ITF). Information and Guidelines for Students Industrial Work Experience Scheme (SIWES). Jos, Nigeria: Industrial Training Fund.

references.citation: Industrial Training Fund (ITF), SIWES handbook or policy (edition and publication details to be confirmed before inclusion).

steps.title: What does the organisation do? (main products or services)
steps.hint: Write at least one true sentence. You can use the organisation's About page, brochure, or ask your supervisor or HR.

steps.title: When and how did it start? Where is it based?
steps.hint: Location and when or how it started, if you know. Leave blank if you cannot confirm this.

steps.title: What is the organisation's mission, vision or main objectives?
steps.hint: Write a short answer or paste a confirmed snippet from its profile.

steps.title: Who heads the organisation (title)? What are the main departments or units? Which one did you work in? Who did you report to?
steps.hint: Name roles or units and who reports to whom.

steps.title: Enter the organogram as an indented tree
steps.hint: Use one role per line and indent each reporting level with two spaces.

steps.title: Who heads the organisation (Job title)
steps.hint: Job title of the organisation's leader (e.g. Managing Director, CEO, CTO).

steps.title: Departments or Operating Units
steps.hint: List of operating divisions or departments.

steps.title: Organisation background not sure
steps.hint: Flag indicating standard details should be used for background.

steps.title: Which unit were you attached to?
steps.hint: Enter the unit name used at your placement.

steps.title: Supervisor job title (optional)
steps.hint: Enter the title only. The supervisor's name is optional.

steps.title: What duties and responsibilities did you perform?
steps.hint: You can confirm relevant logbook entries or add duties you remember.

steps.title: What challenges did you encounter and how were they addressed?
steps.hint: Add two or three real challenge and solution pairs, or select 'I had none'.

steps.title: What would have improved your training?
steps.hint: Tie each recommendation to something you observed.

steps.title: Dedication (optional)
steps.hint: Write a short dedication, or leave this blank to omit the page.

steps.title: Acknowledgement (optional)
steps.hint: Add only names and titles you want to acknowledge. Thank God and family lines are optional and off by default.

steps.title: Acknowledgement statement (optional)
steps.hint: Write a short personal acknowledgement.

steps.title: Industrial supervisor name (optional)
steps.hint: The certification signature line stays blank regardless.

steps.title: Do you have images you'd like to attach to the technical report?
steps.hint: Yes / No. No continues straight on. Yes opens the image step.

steps.title: Paste instead (optional)
steps.hint: Paste text from the company's website, brochure or profile. We use only this pasted text; we do not look the company up.

steps.title: Where did the pasted text come from? (optional)
steps.hint: For example: company About page, brochure, or supervisor.
